verdict.rationale: Flagright's site markets in-product "explainable AI agents" for AML operations and separately offers watchlist screening. This loosely implies agent-assisted review with explanations, but nothing ties the agents to screening-match review or documents how rationale is recorded. missing for 10: documentation that the AI agents review watchlist screening matches, evidence that decision rationale is recorded or persisted, any detail on agent workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to review screening matches with recorded rationale

citations.quote: AI Agents - Supercharge AML operations with explainable AI agents.
Watchlist Screening - Screen with fully configurable matching algorithms.
